title: Oil Breaks $100, but FX Refuses to Follow the Script
summary: Brent broke below $100 after Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West Pipeline, capable of rerouting up to 4 million barrels per day, roughly 4% of global supply, around the Strait of Hormuz, and a senior Iranian official told Reuters Tehran could reopen Hormuz within seven days if Washington eases military pressure. Yet FX didn't confirm the move uniformly: CAD isn't broadly underperforming despite the drop, AUD and NZD diverged sharply from each other with no oil or data catalyst, and Dollar stayed broadly firm on the day's heat map even as oil fell. The post Oil Breaks $100, but FX Refuses to Follow the Script appeared first on ActionForex .
